name: Canadiana
summary: Canadiana refers to both media and iconography distinctive of Canada.
description:
Canadiana refers to both media and iconography distinctive of Canada. It can also refer to an aesthetic lifestyle, and a distinct interior design that features warm, cozy comfort with rugged wilderness (such as the autumn season) roots. It heavily drew inspiration from Canada's vast natural, historic trade eras, harsh winters, and seasonal landscapes where it balances rustic, raw elements such as heavy wools and exposed timbers with a welcoming, clean simplicity as a whole vibe of a country.

It is the Canadian counterpart to Americana and Australiana .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Survival, Nature
